combined_shared_interactions.equation: b + blue_composition - red_composition + blue_shared_synergy - red_shared_synergy + antisymmetric_shared_lane_counter
combined_shared_interactions.information_sharing: champion-role main effects, allied embeddings and lane attack/defense embeddings are reused across every eligible draft and interaction
combined_shared_interactions.objective: mean binary logistic loss + 0.5 * main_l2 * squared composition norm + 0.5 * embedding_l2 * squared embedding norm; side intercept unregularized

composition_with_side_intercept.information_sharing: one regularized champion-role utility is shared across both team orientations and every draft
composition_with_side_intercept.objective: mean binary logistic loss + 0.5 * main_l2 * squared composition norm; side intercept unregularized

shared_allied_synergy.equation: b + blue_composition - red_composition + sum_role_pairs dot(s_blue_role_i, s_blue_role_j) - sum_role_pairs dot(s_red_role_i, s_red_role_j)
shared_allied_synergy.information_sharing: each supported champion-role has one bounded latent vector reused in every allied role-pair dot product
shared_allied_synergy.objective: mean binary logistic loss + 0.5 * main_l2 * squared composition norm + 0.5 * embedding_l2 * squared synergy-embedding norm; side intercept unregularized

shared_lane_counter.equation: b + blue_composition - red_composition + sum_roles dot(a_blue, d_red) - dot(a_red, d_blue)
shared_lane_counter.information_sharing: each supported champion-role has attack and defense vectors reused against every same-role opponent; reversing opponents reverses the counter contrast
shared_lane_counter.objective: mean binary logistic loss + 0.5 * main_l2 * squared composition norm + 0.5 * embedding_l2 * squared attack-and-defense embedding norm; side intercept unregularized

future_holdout_policy: A future sealed temporal holdout may be evaluated only after one prospectively frozen Stage 3.4B candidate passes every material-usefulness, leakage, determinism, privacy, convergence and coverage gate.

hyperparameter_policy.convergence: every optimizer fit must report success and finite parameters; otherwise fail closed
hyperparameter_policy.embedding_initialization: deterministic centered normal scale 0.01 using seed plus canonical configuration and fold hash
hyperparameter_policy.model_selection: minimum mean inner-fold log loss within absolute tolerance 1e-12
hyperparameter_policy.tie_break: largest embedding_l2, then largest main_l2, then smallest total latent dimension, then lexicographically smallest configuration id

bootstrap.rng_and_algorithm: NumPy Generator PCG64 seeded once; independent within-stratum multinomial resampling counts applied to precomputed paired loss differences

metrics.coverage_definition: fraction of the shared role-complete outer test rows receiving a finite probability; because every eligible completed draft contains all five roles, per-role factual coverage equals draft coverage and is reconciled separately for every role

baseline_definitions.fold_local_champion_role_rate_minimum_su: within the training fold count wins and games for each champion-role from that champion's team perspective; retain support >= 10; score as training Blue rate + one half of mean Blue rate minus mean Red rate; use training Blue rate for unseen or unsupported champion-roles
baseline_definitions.stage3_4a_composition_only_l2_0_1_no_int: refit the frozen signed champion-role logistic specification with L2 0.1 and no intercept inside each outer training fold
baseline_definitions.stage3_4a_composition_plus_direct_matchu: refit the frozen signed champion-role plus exact oriented same-lane matchup logistic specification with L2 0.1 and no intercept inside each outer training fold
baseline_definitions.training_fold_blue_win_rate_intercept: predict the arithmetic Blue-win rate observed only in the outer training fold

validation.identical_timestamp_policy: all matches with an identical UTC creation timestamp remain in the same chronological partition

inner.policy: for each cutoff use the three complete one-day UTC intervals immediately preceding it as validation folds with all earlier observations as expanding training

validation.platform_policy: no downsampling; use identical UTC boundaries, require both platforms in every train/test fold, report each platform, and stratify paired bootstrap by platform and outer block
